items.title: Oil prices plunge as supply glut fears outweigh Middle East tensions
items.summary: Investing.com -Oil prices tumbled on Monday, with Brent crude falling as much as 4% after the International Energy Agency’s latest outlook pointed to a substantial global supply surplus in the fourth quarter, overshadowing persistent geopolitical risks in the Middle East.

items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. diesel prices fell below $6 a gallon on Saturday for the first time in more than two months, as declining crude oil prices and weaker seasonal demand eased pressure on fuel costs.
